title: Top 5 Most TERRIFYING Moments In Spaceflight
yt_titles: These 5 Seconds Almost Killed Every Astronaut
The Most Dangerous Moments in Space History
I Can't Believe They Made It Back Alive
hook: Number one left three men freezing with no way home.

items.name: Gemini 8 Spin
items.stat: Capsule tumbled once per second, nearly blacking out Armstrong.

items.name: Mercury-Atlas 6 Heat Shield
items.stat: Ground feared Glenn's heat shield was loose during reentry.

items.name: Soyuz T-10-1 Pad Abort
items.stat: Rocket exploded on the pad; crew yanked clear seconds before.

items.name: STS-1 Columbia Launch
items.stat: First shuttle flew with untested crew and shedding tiles.

items.name: Apollo 13 Explosion
items.stat: Oxygen tank blew 200,000 miles from Earth, crippling the ship.
